data.title: A diary behind the glass

memoryNodes.cue: The fabric and straps belong to equipment used to slow a fall.

memoryNodes.zh: 小飞机旁的飞行员照片
memoryNodes.locationZh: 小飞机旁的飞行员照片

memoryNodes.cue: The traveller changes a plan and keeps going.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 旅行者改变计划，继续行程。

data.situation:
The next room held a folded parachute and a photograph of a pilot beside a small aircraft. Lin had seen these objects in films, but here she could see the straps and worn fabric. A diary page described an intrepid traveller preparing for a flight over an unfamiliar landscape. Beside it, a photograph showed the same traveller waiting under a dripping station roof. From the traveller’s diary
Rain changed the plan. Undeterred, I returned to the station and asked about an overland route. I have made frequent trips, but this is the first time I have had to change so much before leaving. Maya: The label calls the traveller intrepid, but the photograph shows a lot of waiting.
Lin: Perhaps being undeterred doesn’t mean ignoring the weather. He changed the plan.
Maya: And kept the wet ticket in his diary. I like that detail.

readingBlocks.en: The next room held a folded parachute and a photograph of a pilot beside a small aircraft. Lin had seen these objects in films, but here she could see the straps and worn fabric. A diary page described an intrepid traveller preparing for a flight over an unfamiliar landscape. Beside it, a photograph showed the same traveller waiting under a dripping station roof.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一间房陈列着折好的降落伞，以及一名飞行员站在小飞机旁的照片。林曾在电影里见过这些东西，在这里却能看清带子与磨损的布料。一页日记描写一位无畏的旅行者准备飞越陌生地形。旁边照片里，同一个人正在滴水的车站屋顶下等候。

readingBlocks.en:
From the traveller’s diary
Rain changed the plan. Undeterred, I returned to the station and asked about an overland route. I have made frequent trips, but this is the first time I have had to change so much before leaving.
readingBlocks.zh:
旅行者日记摘页
雨改变了计划。我没有因此退缩，回到车站询问陆路路线。我频繁出行，不过这是第一次在出发前就得改这么多。
readingBlocks.title: Inside the case

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: The label calls the traveller intrepid, but the photograph shows a lot of waiting.
Lin: Perhaps being undeterred doesn’t mean ignoring the weather. He changed the plan.
Maya: And kept the wet ticket in his diary. I like that detail.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：标签称这位旅行者无畏，可照片里有很多等候。
林：也许不退缩并不是忽视天气。他改了计划。
玛雅：还把湿票留在日记里。我喜欢这个细节。

glossary.zh: 减缓空中下降速度的降落伞
glossary.note: 可数装备名词；本句陈列物，不是跳伞操作说明。
glossary.example: A folded parachute lies in the display case.
glossary.exampleZh: 一顶折好的降落伞放在展柜里。

externalEvidence.definition: rescue equipment consisting of a device that fills with air and retards your fall

glossary.zh: 驾驶飞机的人员；飞行员
glossary.note: 可数人物名词；领港员、试播节目与试用的动词义另有语境。
glossary.example: The photograph shows a pilot beside an aircraft.
glossary.exampleZh: 照片显示一名飞行员站在飞机旁。

externalEvidence.definition: someone who is licensed to operate an aircraft in flight

glossary.note: 较有叙述色彩的形容词；本句为展览对人物的评价。
glossary.example: The label describes an intrepid traveller.
glossary.exampleZh: 标签描述一位无畏的旅行者。

glossary.zh: 未被困难或阻碍吓退的
glossary.note: undeterred by + 阻碍；表示继续尝试，可同时调整计划。
glossary.example: Undeterred by the rain, the traveller asks about another route.
glossary.exampleZh: 旅行者没有被雨吓退，询问另一条路线。

glossary.note: 形容词frequent trips；与副词frequently travel不同。
glossary.example: The traveller has made frequent trips.

externalEvidence.definition: coming at short intervals or habitually
